scope: Pinned Flash-Next whole text execution path; no model/device execution

entries.operator: Compiled Flash-Next geometry
entries.shape: 48 layers: 36 GDN, 12 QSA; H=2560; vocab=248320; experts=512, top-k=10, FF=640; hyperconnections=4, rank=320
entries.layout: QSA layers 3,7,...47; configurable build geometry is not proof of an inspected model
entries.lifetime: Model/build lifetime
entries.synchronization: Validate actual GGUF geometry against chosen compiled geometry before allocation
entries.state: Dimensions are defaults, not observed model metadata

entries.operator: Token embedding gather
entries.device: GPU; native embedding may read mapped host memory
entries.layout: Native GGUF gather or canonical S2/S4/S8 planes; canonical IQ4_NL explicitly rejected; native placement configurable
entries.lifetime: Weights persistent; output per token/window
entries.synchronization: Gather on ordered stream; retain mapped host storage until GPU reads complete
entries.state: Read-only weights; writes token activation

entries.operator: RMS normalization, gated residual read/write and injection
entries.layout: Float residual; F32 norm; BF16-in-F32 down/up/inject forms checked; fused path may defer prior FFN write
entries.lifetime: R persistent; mixed and inject survive pre -> post; scratch shared in ordered execution
entries.synchronization: Pre/attention/FFN/post must remain ordered; do not reuse mixed/inject while CPU experts are in flight
entries.state: Updates multi-stream R; fused deferred write is part of state frontier

entries.operator: GDN normalization/projections and activation quantization
entries.layout: Per-tensor native/canonical activation choice; Q8_K and Q8_0 canonical scratch can both be needed; BF16 native path has distinct rounding
entries.lifetime: Dense weights persistent; projection scratch per layer call/window
entries.synchronization: Ordered projection -> convolution -> recurrence -> output; retain recorded verifier inputs for accepted-prefix replay
entries.state: Writes transient q/k/v, alpha/beta, z

entries.operator: Causal convolution and SiLU
entries.shape: 10240 channels, conv width4; split q/k/v only after convolution
entries.layout: Persistent C*(d_conv-1) history; fused native preconditions include conv4 and S128; legacy D2D/SiLU fallback
entries.lifetime: One convolution history per GDN layer; output scratch reused only after consumers
entries.synchronization: Convolution before split and q/k L2 normalization; verifier must advance only accepted history
entries.state: Mutates convolution history on token path; speculative window commit has separate rules

entries.operator: Gated DeltaNet recurrence
entries.shape: S128; 16 key heads,48 value heads; state=128*48*128 float elements/layer
entries.layout: Transposed internal state (S,h_v,S), not reference (S,S,h_v); q/k L2 normalization, not v
entries.lifetime: 36 distinct persistent recurrent states; common scratch does not mean shared state
entries.synchronization: Single-token recurrence ordered; verifier defers recurrent mutation except eligible self-commit path
entries.state: Updates GDN recurrent state; accepted-prefix replay is required

entries.operator: GDN output RMS norm, norm weight, sigmoid gate and output projection
entries.layout: rms_norm(o)*ssm_norm*sigmoid(z); this output gate is NOT SiLU
entries.lifetime: Transient gated output and quantization scratch
entries.synchronization: Recurrence output must be ready before gate and projection
entries.state: No separate persistent state beyond preceding GDN state

entries.operator: QSA query/gate, KV and indexer projections, norm and RoPE
entries.shape: 24 query heads x256;2 KV heads x256; query+gate=24*2*256; indexer4x128; RoPE64
entries.layout: Query/gate half-split with 2D copy; Q/K normalization and RoPE; weight type chosen per tensor
entries.lifetime: Projection scratch per call; RoPE tables persistent/possibly borrowed
entries.synchronization: Projection and rotation before KV/index append and attention
entries.state: Advances KV/index state via following operators, not free-standing matmul

entries.operator: QSA KV append, streaming and page resolution
entries.layout: FP16; INT8 + FP16 scale/64; rotated Q4_0 144 B/cell/head; hybrid K8V4 816 B/cell; hybrid mode0 only, MTP ring remains INT8
entries.lifetime: Persistent per QSA layer/sequence; pinned staging and page mappings outlive asynchronous reads
entries.synchronization: Resolve selected blocks before attention; streamed mode host owns authoritative bytes; elastic growth requires no concurrent device work
entries.state: Mode0 all VRAM; mode1 host+VRAM slots; mode2 block%n_slots ring+host resume; rejected speculative cells overwritten before reuse

entries.operator: Indexer key append/pooling, scoring and sparse top-k selection
entries.shape: query4x128; one pooled key/4 cells; budget2048 cells; tail[3,128]
entries.layout: Persistent float tail/pooled rows, block position and constant dead key; capacity-aware graph grids; native and fallback append/selection
entries.lifetime: Tail, pooled index and block cursor persist across tokens
entries.synchronization: Append -> score/top-k -> resolve -> gather/attention; commit restores tail then re-appends accepted keys
entries.state: Speculative appends are not committed history; restore rejected-tail contamination

entries.operator: Sparse attention, optional rotation, sigmoid gate and output projection
entries.layout: Fast pool attention or gathered FP16/INT8/Q4/hybrid paths; optional FWHT and inverse; short native adapter ctx<=256; native F32 versus canonical FP64 sigmoid gate
entries.lifetime: Attention workspace per call/window; KV persistent
entries.synchronization: Selected block resolution before read; inverse rotation before gated output projection
entries.state: Reads visible KV prefix; writes transient attention/output

entries.operator: MoE router, softmax, stable top-k and renormalization
entries.layout: BF16 router; softmax over all experts, descending stable ties by index; native specialization512/top10
entries.lifetime: Weights persistent; activation/ids/weights in mapped doorbell until host pool consumes
entries.synchronization: GPU publishes x/ids/weights then rings sequence last on ordered stream; host load fence precedes reads
entries.state: Full routing required: skip=0, all top10; thresholds/skip paths are not acceptance defaults

entries.operator: Shared expert gate/up, SiLU multiplication, down and scalar sigmoid gate
entries.layout: Each gate/up/down tensor selects its own form/planes and BF16/Q8_K/Q8_0 activation; scalar gate BF16 form required
entries.lifetime: Weights persistent; one workspace reused in stream order
entries.synchronization: Can run after doorbell publication while CPU cold experts execute; must finish before final combine
entries.state: No independent recurrent state

entries.operator: CPU cold routed expert gate/up, SiLU product and down
entries.shape: Each selected expert:2560 ->640 ->2560; multi-token groups reuse weights
entries.layout: Native GGUF types retain metadata; IQ AVX2 and AVX512 are distinct runtime tiers; activation quantizer follows native format; not all kernels share rounding
entries.lifetime: Host expert blobs persistent or staged; stage buffers claimed through read joins and all compute batches
entries.synchronization: Pool partitions rows, not partial row sums; cold-read overlap must join before releasing buffers
entries.state: Only routed cold experts; this is NOT a complete CPU-only decode engine

entries.operator: Hot resident expert execution and weighted MoE/shared reduction
entries.shape: top10 outputs ->2560; GPU hits and CPU misses
entries.layout: Residency lookup selects hit slots; GPU can zero hit rows while mapped CPU outputs carry misses; weighted combination remains GPU-owned
entries.lifetime: Cache slots persistent; miss output and staging scratch survive until GPU consumer is done
entries.synchronization: Launch hits before CPU pool; wait/publish miss completion before combine; shared expert can overlap but must join
entries.state: Numerical order and exact mode depend on path; do not replace with unvalidated host summation

entries.operator: Profile hot-tier fill and adaptive expert residency
entries.shape: Slots indexed by layer/expert; native blob sizes may differ
entries.layout: Residency/table bookkeeping is not expert compute; device slots contain exact expert bytes; per-layer admission option does not imply eviction
entries.lifetime: Persistent across tokens; captured pointers must remain stable
entries.synchronization: Async fill caller-orders copy and reader; profile startup blocking/queued fills need explicit synchronization; verify_slot compares actual bytes
entries.state: Reuse Strata profile/residency/adaptive machinery; FPGA cache lifecycle must preserve publication and ownership

entries.operator: PLE n-gram hash/lookup, row transfer and history update
entries.shape: Layer1 injection; token/history hash selects embedding rows; history channels use row+NG_HIST*channel
entries.layout: Host lookup outside capture; pinned row collected then asynchronous H2D; strided history layout
entries.lifetime: Table persistent; row buffer cannot be recycled before transfer completes; history per session
entries.synchronization: Issue previous lookup must be collected; layer1 PLE before gated residual; caller advances history exactly once/token
entries.state: Token history and GPU history are commit/rollback state, not just lookup scratch

entries.operator: Final gated-residual mix, norm and vocabulary projection
entries.layout: F32 output_hc_norm; BF16-in-F32 down/up; GR read ->Q8_K ->quantized head GEMV; optional native head
entries.lifetime: Head weights persistent; logits per token/window row; shared scratch ordered
entries.synchronization: Finish last FFN residual materialization before head; logits ready before sampler
entries.state: Reads final residual; writes logits

entries.operator: Penalties, top-k/top-p/min-p, temperature, greedy or stochastic pick
entries.layout: Device pointers for logits/out/history; filter order specified; Philox seed/counter per row; greedy<=0 temperature
entries.lifetime: History/counter persistent across requests as configured; per-window history rows differ
entries.synchronization: Host must await device completion before consuming ids; speculative rows require their own histories
entries.state: Sampler draw counter/seed and history must be part of reproducibility/checkpoint inventory

entries.operator: Single-token graph, CPU doorbell and layer barriers
entries.layout: Mapped x/ids/weights, sequence and flag; shared GPU scratch with per-layer persistent state
entries.lifetime: Graph captures pointers; per-token buffers retained until stream completion
entries.synchronization: Graph launch; poll sequence + stream query; load fence; CPU pool; seq_cst/store fence; publish flag; final stream sync. Timeout reports failure, not proven quiescence
entries.state: 20s layer wait timeout is not a safe FPGA cancellation/rollback protocol

entries.operator: Chunked prompt through all operators, grouped experts and state handoff
entries.device: GPU tensor-core GEMMs + host/pinned copy stream; optional CPU share
entries.shape: Chunk[pos0,pos0+n) through48 layers; recurrences walk chunk
entries.layout: Requires native GGUF blocks; quantized projections dequantized to FP16, BF16 as-is; grouped resident experts or host->pinned-ring stream
entries.lifetime: Borrowed expert rings and streams remain live to completion; persistent state handed to decode
entries.synchronization: Cross-stream copy/compute dependencies; all streams idle before borrowed ring returned; native-only prerequisite
entries.state: Leaves GDN/conv, KV/index and PLE at prompt frontier; draft prefill precision can change drafts, not authorize target-logit drift

entries.operator: MTP embedding/hidden projections, own QSA/MoE/head and draft catch-up
entries.device: GPU; currently all draft experts VRAM
entries.layout: Large draft projections Q8_0; dense attention, no target indexer mutation; optional draft Q4; own KV/ring with host resume
entries.lifetime: Separate draft KV and residual; may borrow main embedding/head/windowR; lent expert snapshot preserves captured addresses
entries.synchronization: Reserve before inflight; sync=false caller orders stream; expert lending refuses decode while lent; restore/catch-up accepted prefix
entries.state: Approximate drafts are proposals only; verifier chooses emitted tokens; rejected draft KV must not become target state

entries.operator: Batched target verification through every trunk operator
entries.device: GPU graph + grouped CPU cold experts
entries.shape: T consecutive rows through48 layers; last accepted token plusT-1 drafts
entries.layout: Requires native GPU projections, fused GR/GDN, fast attention/selection, native indexer, profile-filled VRAM tier and device residency table
entries.lifetime: Window inputs/replay buffers and snapshots survive until prefix commit completes
entries.synchronization: Per-token arithmetic equivalence is implementation intent requiring tests, not a proven result from citations
entries.state: Speculative KV/index appends; deferred GDN/conv; snapshots include index tail and PLE; eligible single-token self-commit exception

entries.operator: Accepted-prefix replay/restore and asynchronous commit completion
entries.layout: Replays accepted GDN/conv; restores/re-appends index tail; rejected KV overwritten before reuse
entries.lifetime: Snapshot/replay/commit parameter buffers retained until completion; no early buffer reuse
entries.synchronization: Same-stream next window is ordered; other readers call wait_commit/event synchronization; synchronous path stream-syncs
entries.state: Visibility of candidate/result is not commit. Existing internal API is not opaque versioned FPGA transaction ABI

entries.operator: CPU expert build and runtime ISA selection
entries.device: x86 CPU; non-x86 portable fallback differs
entries.shape: AVX2/FMA/F16C expert objects alongside separate AVX512 and optional AVX1 units
entries.layout: Per-source compiler flags; CPUID FMA/OSXSAVE/AVX/F16C, XCR0 XMM/YMM and AVX2 gates; optional AVX-VNNI function targets do not raise AVX2 floor
entries.lifetime: Build-selected ggml baseline affects fallback arithmetic; runtime force flags cannot make unsafe global compiler flags safe
entries.synchronization: Gate before dispatch; AVX512 VNNI IQ path separate; AVX2 host does not need AVX512 merely because objects exist
entries.state: Dual E5-2696v4 is an AVX2/FMA reference target, not a measured build or throughput result; CPU test targets do not establish CPU-only decode

format_matrix.encoding: FP16 d + uint16 grid/sign words + packed 4-bit scales; nonlinear integer codebook, not FP4
format_matrix.cpu: Native AVX2 IQ256 support, runtime AVX2/FMA/F16C gates and group-size/arithmetic gates; AVX512 tier optional; ggml singleton/fallback depends on build.
format_matrix.gpu: native_mmvq supported via iq_mmvq; grouped/prefill dispatch still requires compatible pack/layout and path validation.
format_matrix.fpga: No verified IQ decoder/MAC/runtime path at this pin pair; LUT/sign/scale semantics and rounding need a dedicated implementation.

format_matrix.encoding: FP16 d +16 packed 2-bit code bytes, fixed integer offset; native GGUF block is not canonical S2 blob
format_matrix.cpu: Native q2_native_kernels(type42) accepts runtime AVX2 or AVX1 tier; AVX2 object uses FMA/F16C; bitplane opt-in changes last bits; portable canonical custom Q2 blob refused.
format_matrix.gpu: native_q2_0_mmvq supported,64 elements/18B. Native and canonical representations cannot be interchanged by name.
format_matrix.fpga: No verified implementation; specify code ordering, signed/offset arithmetic, scale rounding and activation contract.

format_matrix.encoding: FP16 d +qs/qh grid bits +signs +4-bit scales; not Q3_K despite equal110B/256 storage
format_matrix.cpu: AVX2 IQ256 and optional AVX512 IQ512 paths with dispatch, multi-token thresholds and singleton parity/arithmetic restrictions; ggml fallback.
format_matrix.gpu: native_mmvq supported via iq_mmvq; native support is not proof every tensor/operator uses that path.
format_matrix.fpga: No verified nonlinear grid/sign decoder; IQ3_S exact semantics required independently of IQ2_XS.

format_matrix.format: Mixed GGUF and engine tensor forms
format_matrix.encoding: Pack labels are primary quantizers, not per-tensor inventories. Preserve tensor type, dimensions, row bytes, planes, offsets, codebook, scales and any global tail scales.
format_matrix.cpu: Native per-layer/per-role metadata selects activation/dot kernels; fallback requires valid linked/own traits and correct build baseline.
format_matrix.gpu: BF16/F32 norms/router/hyperconnections plus mixed native quantized projections/shared/head/experts. Native MMVQ list is operator-specific, not universal embedding/prefill/cache support.
format_matrix.fpga: FP4/NVFP4/MXFP4 primitives are not IQ2_XS/IQ3_S/Q2_0 implementations. Do not reinterpret or silently requantize.

limitations: Unconfirmed static analysis only. Source bounds/SHA validation is not semantic correctness, a build, model execution or a measured performance result.

No actual model GGUF/header/tensor inventory was supplied or inspected. IQ2_XS primary, Q2_0 speed and IQ3_S quality are intended pack categories only; no exact tensor type map, shard hashes, artifact lengths, alignment, auxiliary forms or model memory budget is established.

No CPU+FPGA complete decode backend is established by these sources. Native CPU expert kernels and CPU-only unit-test targets do not implement embedding, GR, GDN/QSA, PLE, router/shared/head/sampler, prefill, MTP or verifier scheduling on a CPU-only engine.

Non-expert GPU replacement is a required central follow-up: placement/implementation/parity for every operator in entries, including stateful recurrence, KV/index storage, normalization/activation, host lookup, head/sampling and orchestration. Replacing only the expert accelerator leaves the GPU dependency intact.

Verifier explicitly depends on native GPU projections, fused GR/GDN, fast attention/selection, native indexer and profile-filled VRAM resident expert tier/device residency table. CPU+FPGA must provide equivalent contracts or retain GPU; MTP also assumes VRAM experts and own GPU KV.

No openTPU source claim or hardware compatibility is certified here. Strata pin is audited; openTPU pin is integration context only. No FPGA IQ support, DMA coherence, usable endpoint, programming, bitstream, ABI compatibility or throughput is verified.

An opaque versioned transaction ABI, candidate-versus-commit separation, quiescent rollback, timeout quarantine/reset epoch and safe CPU fallback are requirements for future adapters, not demonstrated Strata public APIs.

Broader optional model families, vision/audio, remote multi-GPU implementations and every environment-variable variant were not exhaustively audited. Scope is default compiled Flash-Next text prefill/decode/MTP target path and its source-visible alternatives.
